FROM composer:2 AS composer

ARG TESTING=false
ENV TESTING=$TESTING

WORKDIR /usr/local/src/

COPY composer.lock /usr/local/src/
COPY composer.json /usr/local/src/

RUN composer install --ignore-platform-reqs --optimize-autoloader \
    --no-plugins --no-scripts --prefer-dist \
    `if [ "$TESTING" != "true" ]; then echo "--no-dev"; fi`

FROM appwrite/base:2.1.0 AS base

LABEL maintainer="team@appwrite.io"

ARG VERSION=dev
ARG DEBUG=false
ENV DEBUG=$DEBUG

ENV _APP_VERSION=$VERSION \
    _APP_HOME=https://appwrite.io

RUN if [ "$DEBUG" == "true" ]; then \
    apk add boost boost-dev; \
    fi

WORKDIR /usr/src/code

COPY --from=composer /usr/local/src/vendor /usr/src/code/vendor

# Add Source Code
COPY ./app /usr/src/code/app
COPY ./public /usr/src/code/public
COPY ./bin /usr/local/bin
COPY ./src /usr/src/code/src
COPY ./packages /usr/src/code/packages
COPY ./dev /usr/src/code/dev
COPY ./docker/opcache.ini /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/zz-opcache.ini
COPY ./mongo-init.js /usr/src/code/mongo-init.js
COPY ./mongo-entrypoint.sh /usr/src/code/mongo-entrypoint.sh
COPY ./clickhouse-config.xml /usr/src/code/clickhouse-config.xml
COPY ./clickhouse-init.sh /usr/src/code/clickhouse-init.sh

# Add Installer Templates
COPY ./app/views/install /usr/local/share/appwrite/app/views/install
COPY ./docker-compose.yml /usr/local/share/appwrite/docker-compose.yml
COPY ./mongo-init.js /usr/local/share/appwrite/mongo-init.js
COPY ./mongo-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/share/appwrite/mongo-entrypoint.sh
COPY ./clickhouse-config.xml /usr/local/share/appwrite/clickhouse-config.xml
COPY ./clickhouse-init.sh /usr/local/share/appwrite/clickhouse-init.sh

# Set Volumes
RUN mkdir -p /storage/uploads && \
    mkdir -p /storage/imports && \
    mkdir -p /storage/cache && \
    mkdir -p /storage/config && \
    mkdir -p /storage/certificates && \
    mkdir -p /storage/functions && \
    mkdir -p /storage/debug && \
    chown -Rf www-data:www-data /storage/uploads && chmod -Rf 0755 /storage/uploads && \
    chown -Rf www-data:www-data /storage/imports && chmod -Rf 0755 /storage/imports && \
    chown -Rf www-data:www-data /storage/cache && chmod -Rf 0755 /storage/cache && \
    chown -Rf www-data:www-data /storage/config && chmod -Rf 0755 /storage/config && \
    chown -Rf www-data:www-data /storage/certificates && chmod -Rf 0755 /storage/certificates && \
    chown -Rf www-data:www-data /storage/functions && chmod -Rf 0755 /storage/functions && \
    chown -Rf www-data:www-data /storage/debug && chmod -Rf 0755 /storage/debug

# Executables
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/doctor && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/install && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/interval && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/maintenance &&  \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/migrate && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/stats-resources && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/realtime && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/mqtt && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/schedule && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/schedule-functions && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/schedule-executions && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/schedule-messages && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sdks && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/specs && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/ssl && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/task-time-travel && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/screenshot && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/test && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/upgrade && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/usage-setup && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/vars && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/queue-retry && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/queue-count-failed && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/queue-count-processing && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/queue-count-success && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-builds && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-jobs && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-screenshots && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-certificates && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-databases && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-deletes && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-executions && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-functions && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-mails && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-messaging && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-notifications && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-migrations && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-stats-resources && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-stats-usage && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/worker-webhooks

RUN mkdir -p /etc/letsencrypt/live/ && chmod -Rf 755 /etc/letsencrypt/live/

FROM base AS production

RUN rm -rf /usr/src/code/app/config/specs && \
    find /usr -name '*.a' -delete 2>/dev/null || true && \
    find /usr -type d -name '__pycache__' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && \
    find /usr -name '*.pyc' -delete 2>/dev/null || true

EXPOSE 80

CMD [ "php", "app/http.php" ]

FROM appwrite/base:2.1.0-xdebug AS xdebug

FROM base AS development

# Revalidate bind-mounted source files when development workers reload.
RUN printf 'opcache.validate_timestamps=1\nopcache.revalidate_freq=0\n' > /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/zzz-opcache-dev.ini

COPY ./docs /usr/src/code/docs
COPY ./dev /usr/src/code/dev

# appwrite/base:2.1.0 ships without XDebug, so it cannot reach production or
# Cloud. The -xdebug tag is the same build with the extension; mounting it
# rather than copying keeps xdebug.so out of every layer unless DEBUG asked
# for it, and guarantees an ABI match because both tags are one base build.
RUN --mount=from=xdebug,source=/usr/local/lib/php/extensions,target=/tmp/extensions \
    if [ "$DEBUG" = "true" ]; then \
    cp /tmp/extensions/no-debug-non-zts-*/xdebug.so "$(php-config --extension-dir)/" && \
    cp /usr/src/code/dev/xdebug.ini /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/xdebug.ini && \
    mkdir -p /tmp/xdebug && \
    apk add --update --no-cache openssh-client github-cli; \
    fi

EXPOSE 80
EXPOSE 8080

CMD [ "php", "app/http.php" ]

    image: traefik:3.6
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    container_name: appwrite-traefik
    command:
      - --providers.file.directory=/storage/config

      - --providers.docker=true
      - --providers.docker.exposedByDefault=false
      - --providers.docker.constraints=Label(`traefik.constraint-label-stack`,`appwrite`)
      - --entrypoints.appwrite_web.address=:80
      - --entrypoints.appwrite_websecure.address=:443
      - --entrypoints.appwrite_mqtt.address=:8883
      - --entrypoints.appwrite_mqtt_ws.address=:8084
    ports:
      - ${_APP_HTTP_PORT:-80}:80
      - ${_APP_HTTPS_PORT:-443}:443

      - appwrite

    entrypoint: mqtt
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    container_name: appwrite-mqtt
    image: ${_APP_IMAGE:-appwrite/appwrite}:${_APP_VERSION:-latest}
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "php", "-r", "exit(@fsockopen('127.0.0.1', 1883) ? 0 : 1);"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 20s
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.constraint-label-stack=appwrite
      - traefik.docker.network=appwrite
      # TLS is terminated here (mqtts, :8883) and forwarded as plaintext MQTT to :1883,
      # mirroring how realtime's wss is terminated at the appwrite_websecure entrypoint.
      - traefik.tcp.routers.appwrite_mqtt.entrypoints=appwrite_mqtt
      - traefik.tcp.routers.appwrite_mqtt.rule=HostSNI(`*`)
      - traefik.tcp.routers.appwrite_mqtt.tls=true
      - traefik.tcp.routers.appwrite_mqtt.service=appwrite_mqtt
      - traefik.tcp.services.appwrite_mqtt.loadbalancer.server.port=1883
      # MQTT-over-WebSocket for browser clients: wss://<host>:8084 on its own TLS entrypoint
      # (a dedicated port, not a URL path), the WebSocket sibling of the mqtts TCP router. The
      # port identifies the broker, so a single push host serves both mqtts:// (:8883) and
      # wss:// (:8084). TLS-only, so the reusable CONNECT credential never crosses the wire in
      # the clear; TLS is terminated here and forwarded to the broker's WebSocket listener (:8083).
      - traefik.http.routers.appwrite_mqtt_ws.entrypoints=appwrite_mqtt_ws
      - traefik.http.routers.appwrite_mqtt_ws.rule=PathPrefix(`/`)
      - traefik.http.routers.appwrite_mqtt_ws.service=appwrite_mqtt_ws
      - traefik.http.routers.appwrite_mqtt_ws.tls=true
      - traefik.http.services.appwrite_mqtt_ws.loadbalancer.server.port=8083
    networks:
      - appwrite

# Appwrite Client SDK Configuration
# Copy this file to .env and update with your values

# Appwrite API Endpoint (required for client-side SDK)
VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT=https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1

# Threads (public community forum content, SSR marketing pages)
VITE_THREADS_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT=https://fra.cloud.appwrite.io/v1
VITE_THREADS_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID=656dd556812fe2e5f4ed
VITE_THREADS_DB_ID=main
VITE_THREADS_COL_THREADS_ID=threads
VITE_THREADS_COL_MESSAGES_ID=messages
VITE_THREADS_COL_AUTHORS_ID=authors

# Init ticket image storage (Appwrite Init project, client-side uploads)
VITE_INIT_TICKET_STORAGE_ENDPOINT=https://fra.cloud.appwrite.io/v1
VITE_INIT_TICKET_STORAGE_PROJECT_ID=659868b10fff07726b85
VITE_INIT_TICKET_STORAGE_BUCKET_ID=tickets

# Console profile: cloud (default), self-hosted, or native
# cloud: full feature set (billing, domains, usage stats, org roles, marketing, docs)
# self-hosted: cloud-only features disabled
# native: desktop shell (console features on; init, marketing, docs, and footer off; native app bar on)
VITE_CONSOLE_PROFILE=cloud
# Expose window.__vibes in production when true. Always exposed in development.
VITE_CONSOLE_BROWSER_API=
# Post-signup email verification: false when the backend doesn't enforce it (e.g. local); unset = profile default
VITE_CONSOLE_USER_VERIFICATION=
# Cookie consent banner: false to skip GDPR banner + footer cookie settings (analytics treated as granted); unset = profile default
VITE_CONSOLE_COOKIE_BANNER=
# Browser alerts (Account notifications + build desktop alerts); unset = off
VITE_CONSOLE_BROWSER_ALERTS=
# Pre-launch lock: only /init is public; / redirects there; other pages are blocked.
# Sign-in stays open and returns to /init. Unset = off; true to enable.
VITE_CONSOLE_PRE_LAUNCH=
# Draft blog posts: true to list drafts on /blog and open draft post pages (noindex, never in sitemap/RSS); unset = off
VITE_CONSOLE_BLOG_DRAFTS=
# Dedicated database PITR restore UI (backups restore button and settings restore card); unset = off
VITE_CONSOLE_DATABASE_PITR_RESTORE=
# Extra Git VCS OAuth connect (Origin). GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket stay on. Unset = off
VITE_CONSOLE_EXTRA_VCS_OAUTH=
# Usage statistics: enabled/disabled override; unset = use backend _APP_USAGE_STATS from Console variables
VITE_CONSOLE_USAGE_STATS=
# Screenshot mode: true to enable by default; unset = off. Typing smile toggles it and saves the browser preference.
VITE_CONSOLE_SCREENSHOT_MODE=
# Vite DEV only: header construction bar (unset = on). Set false for agent browsers without localStorage.
# VITE_CONSTRUCTION=false
VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_
# Sentry (optional - leave unset to disable error reporting)
VITE_SENTRY_DSN=

# Plausible Analytics (optional - paste the setup script src to enable tracking).
# Browser loads this URL and posts events to Plausible. SSR exports (.md, llms.txt)
# still POST pageviews server-side to the same origin's /api/event.
VITE_PLAUSIBLE_SCRIPT_SRC=

# Console fingerprint secret (required for cloud: updateConsoleAccess + resume). Must match the backend key (e.g. same as PUBLIC_CONSOLE_FINGERPRINT_KEY). If unset, token is sent unsigned and backend may return 401.
VITE_CONSOLE_FINGERPRINT_KEY=

# Appwrite MCP endpoint (assistant connect + OAuth resource detection).
# Default: https://mcp.appwrite.io
# Local: docker compose up -d appwrite-mcp → http://localhost:8100/
# VITE_APPWRITE_MCP_URL=http://localhost:8100/

# Pre-registered public OAuth2 client id for Agent ↔ Appwrite MCP connect.
# Default: appwrite-agent (seeded once on the authorization server; never DCR).
# VITE_APPWRITE_AGENT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=appwrite-agent

# Playwright e2e (read-only smoke). Prefer email/password; session secret is an optional CI fast-path.
E2E_TEST_EMAIL=
E2E_TEST_PASSWORD=
# E2E_TEST_SESSION_SECRET=
# Optional: pin org/project used by console smoke tests
# E2E_ORG_ID=
# E2E_PROJECT_ID=
# Live self-hosted usage lane: comma-separated categories the current backend does not support
# (requests,databases,storage,messaging,functions,sites). Skips record backend version.
# E2E_USAGE_UNSUPPORTED_SERVICES=
# Optional live seed requests by category, e.g. {"databases":{"url":"http://localhost/v1/..."}}
# Each seed supports url, method, and JSON body. Omitted services are explicitly skipped.
# E2E_USAGE_SEEDS_JSON=

name: CI

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  COMPOSE_FILE: docker-compose.yml:docker-compose.override.yml
  IMAGE: appwrite-dev
  K6_VERSION: '0.53.0'
  DOCKERHUB_AUTH_AVAILABLE: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN != '' }}
  # Older API response format for e2e: 2.3.0, 2.0.0, 1.9.0, 1.8.0, 1.7.0, 1.6.0, 1.5.0, 1.4.0; empty for latest
  API_RESPONSE_FORMAT: ${{ inputs.response_format }}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      # Every release branch, so the nightly channel always has green commits to
      # resolve on the active line without anyone remembering to add it here.
      - '*.x'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      response_format:
        description: 'Response format version to test (e.g., 1.5.0, 1.4.0)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      server: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.server }}
      services: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.services }}
      groups: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.groups }}
      databases: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.databases }}
      modes: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.modes }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Compute changes
        id: changes
        env:
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          MERGE_BASE: ${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
        run: node .github/scripts/changes.mjs

  dependencies:
    name: Checks / Dependencies
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    permissions:
      actions: read
      security-events: write
      contents: read
    uses: "google/osv-scanner-action/.github/workflows/osv-scanner-reusable-pr.yml@a345acffa64b0eaede81a3d9aae6141214d9c8fc" # v2.6.0
    with:
      runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

  security:
    name: Checks / Image
    needs: changes
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.server == 'true'
    runs-on: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)
      && format('gcrunner={0}-security-{1}/runner=standard', github.run_id, strategy.job-index)
      || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: 'recursive'

      - name: Build the Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@bcafcacb16a39f128d818304e6c9c0c18556b85f # v7.1.0
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          load: true
          tags: pr_image:${{ github.sha }}
          target: production

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner on image
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        with:
          image-ref: 'pr_image:${{ github.sha }}'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-image-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner on source code
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ed142fd0673e97e23eac54620cfb913e5ce36c25 # v0.36.0
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          scan-ref: '.'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-fs-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
          skip-setup-trivy: true

      - name: Upload image scan results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@e46ed2cbd01164d986452f91f178727624ae40d7 # v4.35.3
        if: always() && hashFiles('trivy-image-results.sarif') != ''
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-image-results.sarif'
          category: 'trivy-image'

      - name: Upload source code scan results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@e46ed2cbd01164d986452f91f178727624ae40d7 # v4.35.3
        if: always() && hashFiles('trivy-fs-results.sarif') != ''
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-fs-results.sarif'
          category: 'trivy-source'

  checks:
    name: Checks
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.server == 'true'
    runs-on: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)
      && format('gcrunner={0}-checks-{1}/runner=standard', github.run_id, strategy.job-index)
      || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: swoole
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Validate composer.json
        run: composer validate

      - name: Install dependencies
        id: install
        run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress --ignore-platform-reqs

      - parallel:
          - name: Install Node dependencies
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            run: npm ci

          - name: Cache PHPStan result cache
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            uses: actions/cache@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae # v5.0.5
            with:
              path: .phpstan-cache
              key: phpstan-${{ github.sha }}
              restore-keys: |
                phpstan-

      - parallel:
          - name: Audit dependencies
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            env:
              COMPOSER_NO_AUDIT: 0
            run: composer audit

          - name: Run Linter
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            run: composer lint

          - name: Validate packages
            run: bin/monorepo validate

          - name: Check Docker Compose formatting
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            run: npm run lint:compose

          - name: Run Rector
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            run: composer refactor:check

          - name: Run PHPStan
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            run: composer analyze -- --no-progress

          - name: Generate specs
            if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
            run: _APP_STORAGE_LIMIT=5368709120 php app/cli.php specs --version=latest --git=no

  locale:
    name: Checks / Locale
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.server == 'true'
    runs-on: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)
      && format('gcrunner={0}-locale-{1}/runner=small', github.run_id, strategy.job-index)
      || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repo
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Run Locale check
        run: node .github/workflows/static-analysis/locale/index.js

  workflows:
    name: Checks / Workflows
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install zizmor
        run: pipx install zizmor==1.30.1

      - name: Audit workflows
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: zizmor --format github .github

  static-rules:
    name: Checks / Rules
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.server == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write

        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 # 2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          tools: composer:v2
          coverage: none

      - name: Compute changed packages
        id: changed
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          MERGE_BASE: ${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
        run: |
          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            CHANGED=$(ls packages)
          else
            if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
              BASE=$(git merge-base "origin/$BASE_REF" HEAD)
            elif [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "merge_group" ]; then
              BASE="$MERGE_BASE"
            elif git rev-parse -q --verify "$BEFORE" > /dev/null; then
              BASE="$BEFORE"
            else
              BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)
            fi
            CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD -- packages/ | cut -d/ -f2)
            # tooling changes affect every package
            toolchain() {
              git show "$1:composer.lock" | jq --compact-output '[(.packages + ."packages-dev")[]
                | select(.name | IN("laravel/pint", "phpstan/phpstan", "rector/rector", "phpunit/phpunit"))
                | {name, version}] | sort_by(.name)'
            }
            if git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD | grep -qE '^(bin/monorepo|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml|pint\.json)$' \
              || [ "$(toolchain "$BASE")" != "$(toolchain HEAD)" ]; then
              CHANGED=$(ls packages)
            fi
          fi
          CHANGED=$(echo "$CHANGED" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -u \
            | while read -r package; do [ -d "packages/$package" ] && echo "$package"; done)

          if [ -z "$CHANGED" ]; then
            echo "matrix=[]" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0

          # the local checkout); changed packages run registry-resolved —
          # unless a sibling they depend on also changed, which makes the
          # registry combination unbuildable until that sibling releases.
          LINKED=$(bin/monorepo dependents $CHANGED)
          MATRIX=$(
            {
              for package in $LINKED; do
                printf '{"package":"%s","linked":true}\n' "$package"
              done
              for package in $CHANGED; do
                case " $(echo $LINKED) " in
                  *" $package "*) ;;
                  *) printf '{"package":"%s","linked":false}\n' "$package" ;;
                esac
              done
            } | jq --compact-output --slurp 'unique'
          )
          echo "matrix=$MATRIX" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    name: Benchmark
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: gcrunner=${{ github.run_id }}/runner=e2e
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: build
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      packages: read
    env:
      # The before stack is a worktree at an arbitrary older SHA, so its compose file
      # may not gate databases at all. Start the superset on both sides, otherwise the
      # two runs measure different amounts of idle container load rather than the diff.
      COMPOSE_PROFILES: mariadb,mongodb
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        if: ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_AUTH_AVAILABLE == 'true' }}
        uses: docker/login-action@4907a6ddec9925e35a0a9e82d7399ccc52663121 # v4.1.0
        with:
          username: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - parallel:
          - name: Pull Appwrite image
            run: |
              docker pull "${GCRUNNER_REGISTRY_PULL}/appwrite:${IMAGE}-${GITHUB_SHA}"
              docker tag "${GCRUNNER_REGISTRY_PULL}/appwrite:${IMAGE}-${GITHUB_SHA}" "${IMAGE}"
              docker tag "${GCRUNNER_REGISTRY_PULL}/appwrite:${IMAGE}-${GITHUB_SHA}" "${IMAGE}:after"

          - name: Setup k6
            uses: grafana/setup-k6-action@db07bd9765aac508ef18982e52ab937fe633a065 # v1.2.1
            with:
              k6-version: ${{ env.K6_VERSION }}

      - name: Prepare benchmark before
        id: benchmark_before_prepare
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          BENCHMARK_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
        run: |
          git fetch --depth=1 origin "${BENCHMARK_BEFORE_SHA}"
          git worktree add --detach /tmp/appwrite-benchmark-before "${BENCHMARK_BEFORE_SHA}"
          docker build \
            --cache-from "$IMAGE:after" \
            --target development \
            --build-arg DEBUG=false \
            --build-arg TESTING=true \
            --build-arg VERSION=dev \
            --tag "$IMAGE:before" \
            /tmp/appwrite-benchmark-before

      - name: Start before Appwrite
        id: benchmark_before_start
        if: steps.benchmark_before_prepare.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: /tmp/appwrite-benchmark-before
        env:
          _APP_DOMAIN: localhost
          _APP_CONSOLE_DOMAIN: localhost
          _APP_DOMAIN_FUNCTIONS: functions.localhost
          _APP_OPTIONS_ABUSE: disabled
        run: |
          docker tag "$IMAGE:before" "$IMAGE"
          docker compose up -d --wait --no-build
          for attempt in $(seq 1 10); do
            if curl -fsS http://localhost:9520/v1/health/version; then
              break
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" -eq 10 ]; then
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Prepare benchmark files
        run: rm -f benchmark-before-summary.json benchmark-after-summary.json benchmark-before-samples.json benchmark-after-samples.json

      - name: Benchmark before
        if: steps.benchmark_before_start.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: grafana/run-k6-action@de51a7390bdf0ac85a3bef493691bd71d4c7c158 # v1.4.0
        env:
          APPWRITE_ENDPOINT: 'http://localhost:9520/v1'
          APPWRITE_BENCHMARK_DURATION: '1m'
          APPWRITE_BENCHMARK_VUS: '20'
          APPWRITE_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS: '120000'
          APPWRITE_BENCHMARK_SUMMARY_PATH: 'benchmark-before-summary.json'
        with:
          path: tests/benchmarks/http.js
          flags: --quiet --out json=benchmark-before-samples.json
          cloud-comment-on-pr: false
          debug: true

      - name: Stop before Appwrite
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -d /tmp/appwrite-benchmark-before ]; then
            cd /tmp/appwrite-benchmark-before
            docker compose down -v || true
          fi

      - name: Wait for benchmark ports
        if: always()
        run: |
          for port in 9520 9521 9522 9503; do
            for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
              if ! ss -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -Eq "[:.]${port}$"; then
                break
              fi
              sleep 1
            done

            if ss -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -Eq "[:.]${port}$"; then
              echo "Port ${port} is still in use after stopping the before stack"
              ss -ltn
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Start after Appwrite
        env:
          _APP_DOMAIN: localhost
          _APP_CONSOLE_DOMAIN: localhost
          _APP_DOMAIN_FUNCTIONS: functions.localhost
          _APP_OPTIONS_ABUSE: disabled
        run: |
          docker tag "$IMAGE:after" "$IMAGE"
          docker compose up -d --wait --no-build
          for attempt in $(seq 1 10); do
            if curl -fsS http://localhost:9520/v1/health/version; then
              break
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" -eq 10 ]; then
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Benchmark after
        id: benchmark_after
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: grafana/run-k6-action@de51a7390bdf0ac85a3bef493691bd71d4c7c158 # v1.4.0
        env:
          APPWRITE_ENDPOINT: 'http://localhost:9520/v1'
          APPWRITE_BENCHMARK_DURATION: '1m'
          APPWRITE_BENCHMARK_VUS: '20'
          APPWRITE_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS: '120000'
          APPWRITE_BENCHMARK_PREVIOUS_SUMMARY_PATH: '../../benchmark-before-summary.json'
          APPWRITE_BENCHMARK_SUMMARY_PATH: 'benchmark-after-summary.json'
        with:
          path: tests/benchmarks/http.js
          flags: --quiet --out json=benchmark-after-samples.json
          cloud-comment-on-pr: false
          debug: true

      - name: Stop after Appwrite
        if: always()
        run: docker compose down -v || true

      - name: Comment on PR
        if: always()
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          BENCHMARK_BASE_REF: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref || github.event.before }}
          BENCHMARK_HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.sha }}
        with:
          script: |
            const comment = require('./.github/workflows/benchmark-comment.js');
            await comment({ github, context, core });

      - name: Save results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: |
            benchmark-comment.txt
            benchmark-before-summary.json
            benchmark-after-summary.json
            benchmark-before-samples.json
            benchmark-after-samples.json
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Fail benchmark
        if: always() && steps.benchmark_after.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

  # The one required check: skipped jobs pass (change detection skips untouched
  # areas), failed or cancelled ones fail. Benchmark only reports.
  gate:
    name: CI
    if: always()
    needs:
      - changes
      - dependencies
      - security
      - checks
      - locale
      - workflows
      - static-rules
      - packages
      - package
      - build
      - unit
      - e2e_general
      - e2e_security
      - e2e_service
      - e2e_grouped
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check results
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          jq -r 'to_entries[] | "\(.value.result)\t\(.key)"' <<< "$NEEDS"
          failed=$(jq -r '[to_entries[] | select(.value.result == "failure" or .value.result == "cancelled") | .key] | join(", ")' <<< "$NEEDS")
          if [ -n "$failed" ]; then
            echo "::error::Jobs did not pass: $failed"
            exit 1
          fi

name: Console / Production

on:
    # Console versions are apps/console/<version> tags: GitHub releases belong
    # to the server, and console/<version> is the packages/console release tag.
    push:
        tags:
            - 'apps/console/*'
    workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
    group: ${{ github.workflow }}
    cancel-in-progress: false

env:
    ENVIRONMENT: production
    PROJECT: assets
    APPLICATION: console
    DECLARATIVE_OWNER: appwrite-labs
    DECLARATIVE_REPOSITORY: application-configuration
    REGISTRY_GITHUB: ghcr.io
    REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB: docker.io
    IMAGE_NAME: appwrite/new

permissions:
    contents: read

jobs:
    # Every other job waits on this one, so approval rules on console-production
    # gate the whole release: images, manifests, assets and the deploy.
    version:
        environment: console-production
        runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
        outputs:
            tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
        steps:
            - name: Resolve the image tag
              id: version
              env:
                  REF: ${{ github.ref }}
              run: |
                  case "$REF" in
                    refs/tags/apps/console/?*) tag="${REF#refs/tags/apps/console/}" ;;
                    *)
                      echo "::error::Production deploys only from apps/console/<version> tags, not $REF"
                      exit 1
                      ;;
                  esac
                  echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "Deploying $IMAGE_NAME:$tag"

    build:
        needs: version
        permissions:
            contents: read
            packages: write
        # gcrunner has no arm64 runners; that leg cross-builds under QEMU.
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                include:
                    - arch: amd64
                      platform: linux/amd64
                    - arch: arm64
                      platform: linux/arm64
        runs-on: gcrunner=${{ github.run_id }}-console-build-${{ strategy.job-index }}/runner=image
        timeout-minutes: 45
        env:
            DOCKER_BUILD_RECORD_UPLOAD: false
        # Matrix legs share one output map, so each leg has to write to its own
        # key; the leg it does not belong to gets an empty value, which GitHub
        # drops rather than writing over the other leg's digest.
        outputs:
            digest_amd64: ${{ matrix.arch == 'amd64' && steps.build.outputs.digest || '' }}
            digest_arm64: ${{ matrix.arch == 'arm64' && steps.build.outputs.digest || '' }}
        steps:
            - name: Checkout the repo
              uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false

            - name: Set up QEMU
              if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
              uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@99012661954931238ded8c8b007157a8430204e1 # v4.4.0

            - name: Set up Docker Buildx
              uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@37fe631027851001ddb9b187196cc803df7f5f0e # v4.3.0
              with:
                  driver: docker-container
                  cleanup: false

            - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_GITHUB }}
                  username: ${{ github.actor }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Login to Docker Hub
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB }}
                  username: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Build and push by digest
              id: build
              uses: docker/build-push-action@53b7df96c91f9c12dcc8a07bcb9ccacbed38856a # v7.3.0
              with:
                  context: apps/console
                  platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
                  # Pushed by digest, with no tag of its own: the manifest job below
                  # is what tags the merged index, so ${TAG} is the only tag that ever
                  # appears in the registries - no per-arch tags to clean up.
                  outputs: type=image,"name=${{ env.REGISTRY_GITHUB }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }},${{ env.REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}",push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true
                  # Default provenance would push an image index per arch, leaving
                  # imagetools to merge an index of indexes.
                  provenance: false
                  # The CDN base and brand constants are fixed at build time.
                  # Other public configuration comes from the Helm chart at runtime.
                  build-args: |
                      "CDN_ORIGIN=https://cdn.appwrite.io"
                      "VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID=${{ vars.VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID }}"
                      "VITE_COMPANY_NAME=${{ vars.VITE_COMPANY_NAME }}"
                      "VITE_CONTACT_SALES_URL=${{ vars.VITE_CONTACT_SALES_URL }}"
                      "VITE_PRIVACY_EMAIL=${{ vars.VITE_PRIVACY_EMAIL }}"
                  secrets: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN != '' && format('sentry_auth_token={0}', secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN) || '' }}

    manifest:
        permissions:
            contents: read
            packages: write
        needs: [version, build]
        env:
            TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        runs-on: gcrunner=${{ github.run_id }}-console-manifest/runner=deploy
        timeout-minutes: 10
        steps:
            - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_GITHUB }}
                  username: ${{ github.actor }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Login to Docker Hub
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB }}
                  username: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Tag the per-arch digests as one multi-arch manifest
              # Digests are content-addressed, so the same pair is valid in both
              # registries.
              env:
                  DIGESTS: ${{ needs.build.outputs.digest_amd64 }} ${{ needs.build.outputs.digest_arm64 }}
              run: |
                  for registry in "$REGISTRY_GITHUB" "$REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB"; do
                    refs=()
                    for digest in $DIGESTS; do
                      refs+=("$registry/$IMAGE_NAME@$digest")
                    done
                    docker buildx imagetools create --tag "$registry/$IMAGE_NAME:$TAG" "${refs[@]}"
                    docker buildx imagetools inspect "$registry/$IMAGE_NAME:$TAG"
                  done

    build-self-hosted:
        needs: version
        permissions:
            contents: read
            packages: write
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                include:
                    - arch: amd64
                      platform: linux/amd64
                    - arch: arm64
                      platform: linux/arm64
        runs-on: gcrunner=${{ github.run_id }}-console-build-self-hosted-${{ strategy.job-index }}/runner=image
        timeout-minutes: 45
        env:
            DOCKER_BUILD_RECORD_UPLOAD: false
        outputs:
            digest_amd64: ${{ matrix.arch == 'amd64' && steps.build.outputs.digest || '' }}
            digest_arm64: ${{ matrix.arch == 'arm64' && steps.build.outputs.digest || '' }}
        steps:
            - name: Checkout the repo
              uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false

            - name: Set up QEMU
              if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
              uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@99012661954931238ded8c8b007157a8430204e1 # v4.4.0

            - name: Set up Docker Buildx
              uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@37fe631027851001ddb9b187196cc803df7f5f0e # v4.3.0
              with:
                  driver: docker-container
                  cleanup: false

            - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_GITHUB }}
                  username: ${{ github.actor }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Login to Docker Hub
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB }}
                  username: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Build and push by digest
              id: build
              uses: docker/build-push-action@53b7df96c91f9c12dcc8a07bcb9ccacbed38856a # v7.3.0
              with:
                  context: apps/console
                  platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
                  outputs: type=image,"name=${{ env.REGISTRY_GITHUB }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }},${{ env.REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}",push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true
                  provenance: false
                  build-args: |
                      "CDN_ORIGIN="
                      "VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID=${{ vars.VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID }}"
                      "VITE_COMPANY_NAME=${{ vars.VITE_COMPANY_NAME }}"
                      "VITE_CONTACT_SALES_URL=${{ vars.VITE_CONTACT_SALES_URL }}"
                      "VITE_PRIVACY_EMAIL=${{ vars.VITE_PRIVACY_EMAIL }}"
                  secrets: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN != '' && format('sentry_auth_token={0}', secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN) || '' }}

    manifest-self-hosted:
        permissions:
            contents: read
            packages: write
        needs: [version, build-self-hosted]
        env:
            TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        runs-on: gcrunner=${{ github.run_id }}-console-manifest-self-hosted/runner=deploy
        timeout-minutes: 10
        steps:
            - name: Set up Docker Buildx
              uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@37fe631027851001ddb9b187196cc803df7f5f0e # v4.3.0

            - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_GITHUB }}
                  username: ${{ github.actor }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Login to Docker Hub
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB }}
                  username: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Publish the multi-arch self-hosted image
              env:
                  DIGEST_AMD64: ${{ needs.build-self-hosted.outputs.digest_amd64 }}
                  DIGEST_ARM64: ${{ needs.build-self-hosted.outputs.digest_arm64 }}
              run: |
                  set -euo pipefail
                  : "${DIGEST_AMD64:?Missing amd64 digest}"
                  : "${DIGEST_ARM64:?Missing arm64 digest}"
                  for registry in "$REGISTRY_GITHUB" "$REGISTRY_DOCKERHUB"; do
                    image="$registry/$IMAGE_NAME"
                    docker buildx imagetools create --tag "$image:$TAG-self-hosted" \
                      "$image@$DIGEST_AMD64" "$image@$DIGEST_ARM64"
                    docker buildx imagetools inspect "$image:$TAG-self-hosted" --raw \
                      | jq -e '([.manifests[].platform | "\(.os)/\(.architecture)"] | sort) == ["linux/amd64", "linux/arm64"]'
                  done

    publish-assets:
        needs: build
        runs-on: gcrunner=${{ github.run_id }}-console-publish-assets/runner=deploy
        timeout-minutes: 25
        permissions:
            contents: read
            packages: read
        steps:
            - name: Checkout the repo
              uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false

            - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
              uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4
              with:
                  registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_GITHUB }}
                  username: ${{ github.actor }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Extract the deployed images' client assets
              env:
                  DIGEST_AMD64: ${{ needs.build.outputs.digest_amd64 }}
                  DIGEST_ARM64: ${{ needs.build.outputs.digest_arm64 }}
              run: bash .github/scripts/console/extract-assets.sh

            - name: Publish assets to R2
              uses: docker://rclone/rclone@sha256:45401ad7410db1d67ffdb58e19059ad20b0d8e0285a60e38bbec55cc1019c7a5 # 1.75.1
              with:
                  entrypoint: /bin/sh
                  args: .github/scripts/console/publish-assets.sh
              env:
                  RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_TYPE: s3
                  RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_PROVIDER: Cloudflare
                  RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_ENDPOINT: https://285d5ba7177bab8490e237b619b4b9f6.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
                  RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_REGION: auto
                  RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_NO_CHECK_BUCKET: 'true'
                  RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.CONSOLE_PRODUCTION_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
                  RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONSOLE_PRODUCTION_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
                  R2_BUCKET: appwrite-console

    deploy:
        # Never roll out HTML that references assets which failed to publish.
        needs: [version, manifest, publish-assets]
        runs-on: gcrunner=${{ github.run_id }}-console-deploy/runner=deploy
        timeout-minutes: 10
        env:
            TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        # Shared across the staging and production workflows so their deploy
        # jobs never push to application-configuration at the same time.
        concurrency:
            group: declarative-deploy
            cancel-in-progress: false
        steps:
            - name: Get token for ${{ env.DECLARATIVE_REPOSITORY }}
              id: app-token
              uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3
              with:
                  client-id: ${{ vars.DECLARATIVE_DEPLOYMENT_GITHUB_APP_ID }}
                  private-key: ${{ secrets.DECLARATIVE_DEPLOYMENT_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
                  owner: ${{ env.DECLARATIVE_OWNER }}
                  repositories: ${{ env.DECLARATIVE_REPOSITORY }}
                  permission-contents: write

            - name: Checkout ${{ env.DECLARATIVE_REPOSITORY }}
              uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2 # zizmor: ignore[artipacked] the push below uses these credentials
              with:
                  repository: ${{ env.DECLARATIVE_OWNER }}/${{ env.DECLARATIVE_REPOSITORY }}
                  token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

            - name: Update image reference
              run: yq -i '.global.image.repository = strenv(IMAGE_NAME) | .global.image.tag = strenv(TAG)' "$PROJECT/$ENVIRONMENT/$APPLICATION/default.yaml"

            - name: Commit and push
              run: |
                  git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
                  git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
                  git add "$PROJECT/$ENVIRONMENT/$APPLICATION/default.yaml"
                  if git diff --cached --quiet; then
                    echo "No changes to commit"
                  else
                    git commit -m "chore($ENVIRONMENT): $APPLICATION image to $IMAGE_NAME:$TAG"
                    git push
                  fi

name: Console / Snippets QA (Android)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT: ${{ vars.CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT }}
  CODE_SNIPPET_QA_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.CODE_SNIPPET_QA_PROJECT_ID }}
  APP_ID: io.appwrite.connectqa
  # write-env.mjs overwrites gradle.properties, dropping the templates'
  # org.gradle.jvmargs, and the 8-vCPU runner spawns twice the dex workers
  # of ubuntu-latest - D8 then OOMs the default daemon heap ("Error while
  # merging dex archives"). Give every Gradle daemon an explicit 4 GB heap.
  GRADLE_OPTS: -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: apps/console/tests/connect-qa/android

jobs:
  qa:
    name: ${{ matrix.id }}
    # Still on RunsOn: the emulator needs KVM and gcrunner has no nested virt.
    runs-on: runs-on=${{ github.run_id }}/family=c8i+m8i/cpu=8/nested-virt/image=ubuntu24-full-x64/volume=80gb
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      # Every lane downloads a Gradle distribution, an SDK platform and an
      # emulator image through the runners' shared NAT egress, and the
      # endpoints (services.gradle.org especially) reset connections when
      # all seven pull at once - which lane loses is random, so the matrix
      # flapped between runs. Three at a time trades wall clock for the
      # determinism a QA workflow needs.
      max-parallel: 3
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: react-native
            sdk: react-native
            snippets: react-native
            template: ''
            config_file: .env
            create: npx -y create-expo-app@latest "$APP_DIR" --template blank-typescript --no-install
            configure: jq --arg id "$APP_ID" '.expo.android.package = $id' app.json > app.json.tmp && mv app.json.tmp app.json
            # react-native-appwrite hard-pins expo-file-system 18.*.*, so npm
            # nests a second copy next to the Expo SDK 54 app's 19.x. Expo
            # autolinking then mixes both versions' native code and the app
            # dies at launch with NoClassDefFoundError on
            # FilePermissionModule (removed in 19). Override it to the app's
            # own version until appwrite/sdk-for-react-native#114 ships; the
            # auth flow under test does not touch the file APIs.
            install: >-
              npm install && npm install react-native-appwrite &&
              npx expo install expo-file-system &&
              npm pkg set 'overrides.expo-file-system=$expo-file-system' &&
              npm install
            # --clean keeps prebuild idempotent so the build step can retry.
            build: npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install --clean && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleRelease --no-daemon
            apk: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

          - id: flutter
            sdk: flutter
            snippets: flutter
            template: ''
            config_file: env.json
            copy_to: .
            create: flutter create --org io.appwrite --project-name connectqa "$APP_DIR"
            configure: 'true'
            install: flutter pub add appwrite
            build: flutter build apk --debug --dart-define-from-file=env.json
            apk: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk

          - id: android-kotlin
            sdk: android
            framework: kotlin
            snippets: android/kotlin
            template: android
            config_file: gradle.properties
            copy_to: app/src/main/java/io/appwrite/connectqa
            create: mkdir -p "$APP_DIR"
            configure: >-
              rm -f app/src/main/java/io/appwrite/connectqa/build.gradle.kts &&
              for f in app/src/main/java/io/appwrite/connectqa/*.kt; do
              printf 'package io.appwrite.connectqa\n\n' | cat - "$f" > "$f.tmp" &&
              mv "$f.tmp" "$f"; done
            install: 'true'
            # The AGP 9 opt-out flags keep the template on the external Kotlin
            # plugin and classic DSL; they live here because write-env.mjs
            # overwrites gradle.properties with the Appwrite variables.
            build: >-
              gradle assembleRelease --no-daemon -Pandroid.useAndroidX=true
              -Pandroid.builtInKotlin=false -Pandroid.newDsl=false
            apk: app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

          - id: android-java
            sdk: android
            framework: java
            snippets: android/java
            template: android-java
            config_file: gradle.properties
            copy_to: app/src/main/java/io/appwrite/connectqa
            create: mkdir -p "$APP_DIR"
            configure: >-
              rm -f app/src/main/java/io/appwrite/connectqa/build.gradle.kts &&
              for f in app/src/main/java/io/appwrite/connectqa/*.java; do
              printf 'package io.appwrite.connectqa;\n\n' | cat - "$f" > "$f.tmp" &&
              mv "$f.tmp" "$f"; done
            install: 'true'
            build: >-
              gradle assembleRelease --no-daemon -Pandroid.useAndroidX=true
              -Pandroid.builtInKotlin=false -Pandroid.newDsl=false
            apk: app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

          - id: capacitor
            sdk: web
            framework: capacitor
            using: vite
            snippets: web/capacitor
            template: ''
            java: temurin-21
            config_file: .env
            copy_to: .
            create: npx -y create-vite@latest "$APP_DIR" --template vanilla-ts
            configure: 'true'
            install: npm install && npm install appwrite @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android
            # rm -rf android keeps `cap add` idempotent so the build step
            # can retry (it refuses to add an existing platform).
            build: npm run build && rm -rf android && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
            apk: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

          - id: ionic
            sdk: web
            framework: ionic
            using: vite
            snippets: web/ionic
            template: ionic
            java: temurin-21
            config_file: .env
            copy_to: .
            create: npx -y create-vite@latest "$APP_DIR" --template react-ts
            configure: 'true'
            install: npm install && npm install appwrite @ionic/react @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android
            build: npm run build && rm -rf android && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
            apk: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

          - id: tauri
            sdk: web
            framework: tauri
            using: vite
            snippets: web/tauri
            template: tauri
            config_file: .env
            copy_to: .
            create: npx -y create-tauri-app@latest "$APP_DIR" --template vanilla-ts --manager npm --yes
            configure: 'true'
            install: npm install && npm install appwrite
            build: npm run tauri android init -- --ci && npm run tauri android build -- --apk --debug
            apk: src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/debug/app-universal-debug.apk

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # GitHub-hosted runners left only ~14 GB free, which the SDK caches,
      # Gradle builds, and the emulator system image + AVD overflowed (flutter
      # and react-native died with ENOSPC mid-run) - the RunsOn profile
      # provisions an 80 GB volume instead, so no cleanup step is needed.
      - name: Check Appwrite variables
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT" ] || [ -z "$CODE_SNIPPET_QA_PROJECT_ID" ]; then
            echo "::error::Set the CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT and CODE_SNIPPET_QA_PROJECT_ID repository variables."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      # jdx/mise-action bootstraps the mise binary from GitHub releases, and
      # that curl kept getting connection-reset through these runners'
      # egress (GitHub throttles the anonymous per-IP bucket hard). mise's
      # apt repository rides a different CDN and apt retries politely, so
      # install the binary from there and wire up the env the action would
      # have set.
      - name: Install mise
        run: |
          sudo install -dm 755 /etc/apt/keyrings
          curl -fsSL --retry 10 --retry-all-errors https://mise.jdx.dev/gpg-key.pub \
            | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/mise-archive-keyring.gpg > /dev/null
          echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/mise-archive-keyring.gpg arch=amd64] https://mise.jdx.dev/deb stable main" \
            | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mise.list > /dev/null
          sudo apt-get update -qq -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist="sources.list.d/mise.list" -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts="-" -o APT::Get::List-Cleanup="0"
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq mise
          echo "MISE_YES=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Install tooling via mise (node, maestro, java, gradle)
        env:
          # mise pulls the Temurin JDK and maestro from GitHub releases;
          # authenticated requests get much friendlier rate limits than the
          # anonymous per-IP bucket these runners' shared egress falls into.
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          mise trust
          # Capacitor's android library ships Java 21 bytecode; the shared
          # default stays on 17 because React Native and Flutter test it.
          # Export JAVA_HOME too: gradlew resolves it before consulting PATH.
          # The JDK never comes from mise here - its Adoptium download was by
          # far the most throttled request on these runners ("refused stream"
          # for 10+ minutes at a time). The image ships JDK 17; any other
          # version comes from Ubuntu's archive, served by a regional mirror
          # instead of the CDNs that throttle this shared egress.
          find_jdk() {
            eval "from_env=\"\${JAVA_HOME_${1}_X64:-}\""
            for dir in "$from_env" "/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-$1-jdk-amd64" \
                "/usr/lib/jvm/java-$1-openjdk-amd64"; do
              if [ -n "$dir" ] && [ -x "$dir/bin/java" ]; then
                echo "$dir"
                return 0
              fi
            done
            return 1
          }
          install_tools() {
            ver="${{ matrix.java || 'temurin-17' }}"
            ver="${ver#temurin-}"
            if ! jdk="$(find_jdk "$ver")"; then
              sudo apt-get update -qq || return 1
              sudo apt-get install -y -qq "openjdk-$ver-jdk" || return 1
              jdk="$(find_jdk "$ver")" || return 1
            fi
            echo "JAVA_HOME=$jdk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            # The mise config lists java, and `mise run` (the maestro task)
            # auto-installs missing config tools - which would put the
            # throttled download back in the middle of the test.
            echo "MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS=java" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            mise install node maestro gradle || return 1
          }
          # On RunsOn all matrix jobs share a few NAT egress IPs, and the
          # simultaneous JDK/node downloads can get throttled per-IP (http2
          # "refused stream"). Retry with backoff and jitter absorbs it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if install_tools; then
              exit 0
            fi
            delay=$((attempt * 45 + RANDOM % 30))
            echo "::warning::Tool install failed (attempt $attempt), retrying in ${delay}s"
            sleep "$delay"
          done
          install_tools

      # GitHub-hosted ubuntu runners preinstall the Android SDK; the RunsOn
      # image does not, so Gradle dies with "SDK location not found". Install
      # cmdline-tools and accept the licenses - Gradle/AGP then auto-installs
      # whatever platforms and build-tools each lane declares, and the
      # emulator runner installs the system image through sdkmanager.
      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@9fc6c4e9069bf8d3d10b2204b1fb8f6ef7065407 # v3.2.2

      # Tauri's Rust cross-compile does not go through AGP's auto-install; it
      # needs the NDK on disk and NDK_HOME exported.
      - name: Install Android NDK (Tauri only)
        if: matrix.id == 'tauri'
        run: |
          sdkmanager --install "ndk;27.1.12297006"
          echo "NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/27.1.12297006" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/27.1.12297006" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install Flutter
        if: matrix.id == 'flutter'
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2.23.0
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install Rust (Tauri only)
        if: matrix.id == 'tauri'
        run: rustup target add aarch64-linux-android armv7-linux-androideabi i686-linux-android x86_64-linux-android

      - name: Scaffold starter app
        run: |
          APP_DIR="app-$(date +%s)-$RANDOM"
          echo "APP_DIR=$APP_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          ( ${{ matrix.create }} )
          if [ ! -d "$APP_DIR" ]; then
            echo "::error::Scaffold did not produce $APP_DIR"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Paste Connect snippets over the starter
        run: |
          SRC="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/apps/console/src/components/pages/projects/\$projectId/shared/connect-snippets/${{ matrix.snippets }}"
          DEST="$APP_DIR/${{ matrix.copy_to || '.' }}"
          mkdir -p "$DEST"
          cp -Rv "$SRC/." "$DEST/"

      - name: Apply QA harness overlay and configure the app
        run: |
          TEMPLATE="${{ matrix.template }}"
          if [ -n "$TEMPLATE" ] && [ -d "templates/$TEMPLATE" ]; then
            cp -Rv "templates/$TEMPLATE/." "$APP_DIR/"
          fi
          cd "$APP_DIR"
          ${{ matrix.configure }}

      - name: Install dependencies + Appwrite SDK
        run: |
          cd "$APP_DIR"
          ${{ matrix.install }}

      - name: Write env file (derived from connect-snippets.ts)
        run: |
          node ../write-env.mjs "${{ matrix.sdk }}" "${{ matrix.framework || matrix.sdk }}" "${{ matrix.using || matrix.sdk }}" "$APP_DIR"
          cat "$APP_DIR/${{ matrix.config_file }}"

      - name: Build the APK
        run: |
          cd "$APP_DIR"
          # First attempts can die on throttled downloads (gradle wrapper
          # dists, SDK components) through the runners' shared egress.
          # Gradle resumes from its caches on retry, and the build commands
          # are idempotent; real build errors still fail all three attempts.
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
            if ( ${{ matrix.build }} ); then
              break
            elif [ "$attempt" = 4 ]; then
              exit 1
            fi
            # The resets against services.gradle.org persisted for minutes,
            # so spread the attempts out rather than burning them quickly.
            delay=$((attempt * 60 + RANDOM % 30))
            echo "::warning::Build failed (attempt $attempt), retrying in ${delay}s"
            sleep "$delay"
          done
          APK="$PWD/${{ matrix.apk }}"
          if [ ! -f "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::Build did not produce ${{ matrix.apk }}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK_PATH=$APK" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          ls -lh "$APK"

      - name: Assert the endpoint is embedded in the APK
        run: |
          # Tauri embeds the frontend assets brotli-compressed inside the
          # Rust library, so strings-scanning the APK cannot see them;
          # check the Vite build output that gets embedded instead.
          if [ "${{ matrix.id }}" = "tauri" ]; then
            if ! grep -rqF "$CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT" "$APP_DIR/dist"; then
              echo "::error::$CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT is not present in the Vite build output - the env vars never reached the bundle."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Endpoint found in the Vite build output."
            exit 0
          fi
          if ! unzip -p "$APK_PATH" | strings | grep -qF "$CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT"; then
            echo "::error::$CODE_SNIPPET_QA_ENDPOINT is not present in the APK - the env vars never reached the bundle."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Endpoint found in the bundled assets."

      - name: Install and run the Maestro flow on an emulator
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@a421e43855164a8197daf9d8d40fe71c6996bb0d # v2.38.0
        with:
          api-level: 34
          target: google_apis
          arch: x86_64
          # Without a profile the AVD is a tiny 320x640 screen, which
          # truncates the app's greeting text and breaks the flow's
          # exact-text asserts (seen on the ionic lane).
          profile: pixel_5
          ram-size: 4096M
          disable-animations: true
          emulator-options: -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim -camera-back none -no-snapshot
          working-directory: apps/console/tests/connect-qa/android
          # android-emulator-runner executes each script line as a separate
          # `sh -c`, so anything multi-line lives in run-maestro.sh instead.
          script: |
            # System ANR dialogs ("Pixel Launcher isn't responding" while the
            # emulator settles under CI load) sit on top of everything and
            # fail every visibility assert - suppress them.
            adb shell settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1
            adb install -r "$APK_PATH"
            adb logcat -c
            bash run-maestro.sh

      - name: Collect logs and app source
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          if [ -d "$HOME/.maestro/tests" ]; then
            cp -R "$HOME/.maestro/tests/." artifacts/maestro-default-output/ || true
          fi
          if [ -n "$APK_PATH" ] && [ -f "$APK_PATH" ]; then
            cp "$APK_PATH" artifacts/ || true
          fi
          if [ -n "$APP_DIR" ] && [ -d "$APP_DIR" ]; then
            # target/ and gen/ are Tauri's Rust build output and generated
            # Android project - without them the tauri artifact was ~2 GB,
            # which took longer to upload than the test took to run.
            zip -qr artifacts/app-source.zip "$APP_DIR" \
              -x "*/node_modules/*" "*/.git/*" "*/build/*" "*/.gradle/*" \
              "*/dist/*" "*/.expo/*" "*/Pods/*" "*/target/*" "*/gen/*" || true
          fi

      - name: Upload Maestro logs and screenshots
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: connect-qa-android-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: apps/console/tests/connect-qa/android/artifacts/
          if-no-files-found: warn
